title: This is a #prayer for #remnants... Pray along and share
paragraphs: When Moses carried out God's eternal plans and for his generation, God God had to put him through 40 years of test in the wilderness. So, it's not easy. That's why we have very few remnants all over the world. This ministry is for remnants. This ministry is for ascension into the realms of God. I know the uniqueness of this ministry. I know what what I know the calling of this assignment. Father, I pray, Lord, that you open the eyes of your people oh, to seek the deep things of your spirit.

Shali barito from our loashes. Teach me your ways, Lord. Teach me the path of righteousness. Show me your path. Teach me the way. Show me thy path of righteousness. Lahe shabalidas. Leframina toratoshaziadosh. Eshalinambetorandomaralidosh. Leframetoshakila. Elemiatoshashahi. Oh. Lehila, show me the scripts of THE SPIRIT BEFORE CREATION THAT I HAVE ORDAINED BEFORE THE FOUNDATION OF THE WORLD. SHOW ME, OH GOD, THE WAY TO THE HIDDEN WISDOM OF GOD. PRAY. CREATE A PRAYER LANGUAGE FROM the revelation of scriptures.

CREATE A PRAYER LANGUAGE FROM THE WORD OF GOD. OH GOD, SHOW ME THE HIDDEN PATHS THAT LEADS INTO YOUR PREORDAINED GLORY FOR MAN. SHOW ME THE WAY. TEST MY HEART. SHOW ME, OH GOD. SHOW ME THE PATH OF RIGHTEOUSNESS. SHOW ME THE PATHS OF YOUR CRUSHING. Show me the paths of your crushings. Show me the sights of the hidden places OF THE SCROLLS OF YOUR eternal plans. Take me through the scotches of the spirit. Take me through the the the THE CLEFT OF THE ROCK. THE HOT PLACE OF THE MOUNTAINS. THE COALS OF FIRE.

THE HIDDEN PATHS OF YOUR RIGHTEOUS DOINGS. SHOW ME YOUR INTENTIONS. MELT ME. MOLD ME. PARDON ME, OH GOD, TO ALIGN WITH YOUR PLANS AND PURPOSES. PRAY. THIS IS BEYOND HEALING. THIS IS BEYOND A CAR. THIS IS BEYOND A HOUSE OR A JOB. RISE ABOVE IT. THIS IS BEYOND PREACHING. IT'S BEYOND OPENING A CHURCH. Show me, oh God. LET'S SAY "HALLELUJAH." SHOW ME THE PATH OF BROKENNESS. SHOW ME THE PATH OF BROKENNESS. THE FIRST DOORS INTO YOUR ETERNAL PLANS. TAKE ME THROUGH THE PROCESS. NEVER ALLOW ME TO PREACH THE PROCESS.

Develop the servants. Purge your servants. TEST OUR INTENTIONS. CHALLENGE OUR HEARTS. BRING US TO THE PLACE OF PRAYER, the place of humanity, THE PLACE OF ASCENSION. OH, TAKE US INTO THE DIMENSIONS OF LIGHT. MAKE US CUSTODIANS OF LIGHT THAT WE MIGHT BECOME CREATURES ON the hills of influence over nations. Your throne is ON THE HILLTOP. YOU ARE A CITY ON THE HILL THAT CANNOT BE HID. TAKE YOUR THRONE ON THE HILL. Take on the wings OF AN EAGLE. ASCEND INTO THE hill of the Lord.

COME ON, ASCEND INTO THE hill of the Lord. FOR THIS IS BEYOND MONEY. IT IS BEYOND MATERIAL THINGS. FOR THESE THINGS OF THIS WORLD SHALL PERISH. THEY WILL PASS AWAY, BUT THE PURPOSES OF GOD remain forever. Establish us IN YOUR ETERNAL PLANS. MANY have lost it because of their greed. Many have broken it, but thank God that still many who have not defiled themselves with the corruption of lust of this world. FATHER, WE THANK YOU THAT THERE IS STILL MANY WHO YOU HAVE PRESERVED YOURSELF UNDEFILED. OH, HALLELUJAH.

HALLELUJAH. HALLELUJAH. THANK YOU, LORD JESUS. Thank you, Lord Jesus. That there are still holy, righteous pastors across the world. Thank you that there are still GREAT SONS OF GOD, SAINTS, righteous men and women ALL ACROSS THE WORLD THAT WORSHIP you in SPIRIT AND IN TRUTH. THANK YOU, LORD JESUS. THERE ARE men and women who have not taken the mark of the beast. They have not compromised their faith for greed and and and material accusations of this world. Thank you, Lord, BECAUSE YOUR GLORY HAS BEGUN TO PURIFY.

YOUR GLORY HAS BEGUN TO SIFT. YOUR GLORY HAS BEGUN TO SEPARATE THE FAKE FROM THE REAL, THE FOOLISH FROM THE WISE. THANKS BE TO OUR FATHER IN HEAVEN. FOR YOUR JUDGMENT IS JUST. Your judgment is pure. Oh. THE KING HAS JUDGED. The king has begun the judgment. Who can stand the judgment of the king? Who can stand the judgment of Yeshua? Oh, Lord, we thank you. We thank you, Lord Jesus. WE THANK YOU, YESHUA. YESHUA. YESHUA. WOO. HALLELUJAH.

WE join the 24 elders to cast down our crowns and portray on the floor and say, "Worthy, worthy, worthy is the lamb that was slain." Oh, we worship the king. Blessed thy name, Yeshua. Precious seed precious seed Jagalal THE FREEDOM OH. OH. THE SEED MASHABALA THE VENOM THE SHAM CHAMBER ON THE HOLY HILLS OF GOD. THE CITY OF LIGHT IS DESCENDING ON THE HOLY HILL OF GOD. ALL NATIONS SHALL GO. THEY SHALL GO UP TO THE CITY ON THE HILL. HALLELUJAH! HALLELUJAH! WOO! FIRE! FIRE! FIRE! THE CITY OF LIGHT IS DESCENDING.

THE CITY OF GOD IS COMING ON THE HILL OF GOD. HALLELUJAH! HALLELUJAH! YESHUA! WOO! HALLELUJAH! HALLELUJAH! AMEN. THANK YOU, LORD. THANK YOU, LORD.
